evals.prompt: /review-sessions 지난 2주 세션을 돌아보고 결정론으로 옮길 후보를 보고서로 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: The run counts every session with the bundled script, reads only the windows and five strict-read summaries the script selected, writes candidates.json with a proposed form and owner per candidate, renders one offline HTML report, shares its address, and leaves one line in the conversation. It edits no skill, hook, setting, or repository file.
expectations: It runs the bundled scan before reading anything and never loads whole session logs into context.
Every candidate names a deterministic form and owner, the judgment that stays with the agent, and what a re-measurement would confirm.
Harness-owned friction and product-judgment corrections appear in the collapsed buckets, not as candidates.
The report opens offline and the conversation carries only the candidate count and the most expensive one.
No fix, pull request, follow-up file, or instruction edit is made.

evals.prompt: /review-sessions pr 위임을 고친 #127이 머지된 뒤 효과가 있었는지 재측정해줘.
evals.expected_output: The run splits the signal table by the SKILL.md text hash sessions loaded (from skill_versions in findings.json) rather than by merge date alone, chooses the hash of the skill whose text changed, reports before/after and unclassified counts for the delegation signal, and says which sessions ran an older installed copy.
expectations: It uses --split-hash with the newer text hash of the skill whose text changed (merge or triage-issues, not pr, which the missed sessions never loaded), or explains why only a date split was possible.
It reports before and after counts for delegation_pr and does not claim the fix worked from a date split alone.
It writes nothing except the report folder.

evals.expected_output: With no signal past the threshold, the run renders the report in its empty state with the re-measurement table and strict reads only, and says no candidate passed.
expectations: candidates.json has an empty candidates list and the report shows the empty state.
It does not lower the threshold to manufacture a candidate.
It still lists the strict-read sessions it sampled.
